family: R3-N4 neutral: limit-entry patience (entry_expiry_bars) matrix on frozen v30 isotonic-4 x {1x, dd_guard}
hypothesis: Limit-entry patience (how many 5-min bars a resting entry limit stays live after signal close) may move the fill-rate vs fill-quality frontier: short patience (6 bars = 30 min) skips late fills; long patience (24 bars = 2 h) harvests more fills at possibly worse prices. Varying ONLY entry_expiry_bars in ExecutionConfig on the frozen v30 isotonic-4 signal set (94 signals, scores untouched) tests this in isolation. Exploratory only.
base_source: data/processed/swing_regime_research_v4/config.json entry_expiry_bars (read before running; equals frozen per-signal entry_expiry_bars column value 12, which is inert metadata — engines use ExecutionConfig only)
expiry_rule: base is 12, so matrix is {base/2, base, base*2} = {6, 12, 24} bars of 5-min candles (30 min / 60 min / 120 min patience)
control: base-expiry e12_1x normal must reproduce published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
frozen: identical frozen 94-signal set for every branch; no filtering, no refit; ONLY ExecutionConfig.entry_expiry_bars varies (6/12/24); max_holding_bars=2016 (7d*288), tp1_fraction=0.5, intrabar_policy=stop_first frozen
causality_note: entry_expiry_bars is a frozen constant per branch (no adaptation, no lookahead); entry window is signal_index+1 .. signal_index+expiry inclusive in both run_backtest and run_stress
dd_guard_reference: base-expiry control (e12_1x) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times (all branches share the same 94 signal times; only leverage differs). Disclosed shared-reference design per v11 (deviation from v03 own-book reference) to keep expiries comparable.
